_doc: Line parts chosen by rules with slot=<name>, en (AL-52, mirror of ru slots.json from AL-51, DIALOGUE_GEN §5.4, §6.3). Slots: noise.open (slips by state and doubt), voice.open / voice.tail (voice of a trait and age), tone.open / tone.tail (tone). A line is noise.open + tone.open|voice.open + the main line + voice.tail|tone.tail; an empty slot writes nothing. Same arguments as the main line. An .open ends with a space or ': ', a .tail starts with a space.
slot.noise.drunk: Wait… what was I… ah, right:
slot.noise.scared: My knees are shaking as I say it:
slot.noise.tired: Oh, my legs won't hold me…
slot.noise.hungover: I need a drop of ale… fine:
slot.voice.sociable.tail: Not a word to anyone, mind!
slot.voice.unscrupulous.open: Listen, there's a deal in it:
slot.voice.curious.tail: I'd love to know how it really went.
slot.voice.gluttonous.tail: Nearly put me off my supper. Nearly.
slot.voice.lazy.open: Can't be bothered wagging my tongue, but
slot.voice.diligent.open: No time for this, but I'll say it:
slot.voice.family_minded.tail: I just want my own kept safe.
Look after your family, that's what.
slot.voice.stubborn.tail: Cut me if you like, that's how it was.
slot.voice.fickle.tail: Or not. I don't remember now.
slot.voice.fastidious.tail: Ugh, makes me sick to think of it.
slot.voice.old.open: I remember the old days… ah, never mind:
slot.voice.child.open: Mum says not to tell, but
slot.tone.pleading.open: For the love of all that's holy,
slot.tone.noble.open: If I may report, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}:
